item.title: 2019-05-12 Infinity
item.description: Am I the only one who thinks about infinity? About how there’s no next real number, or no first yesterday or last tomorrow; no final breath, no end to the sky, no width in a line.

item.title: 2020-03-15 The night sky is no longer black
item.description: The night sky is no longer black, it is yellow; the pus of the city lights excretes its foul waste onto the pure visage of darkness.
